title: AIS Senior Scholars' Basket of Journals
lead: The AIS Senior Scholars' Basket is the widely used shortlist of leading information systems journals. Otero indexes the current 11-journal basket as a read-only literature library.
why: Researchers, doctoral programs, and hiring committees treat this list as the field's core venues. The names below are the official English titles. Each row opens that journal's articles in the Otero library.
